title: Worth every cent!
text: We had SUCH a wonderful experience with Paola. We're so grateful! We learnt so much about Alhambra, and she was fantastic in engaging with our five-year-old and keeping him interested throughout (which was definitely a challenge, but she was up for it!). Would absolutely recommend, and we're so glad we did it.
author: KateARobertson

title: Interesting and entertaining
text: Guide was very friendly and knew all there is to be known about the Alhambra. The three hours went by really fast. It was never boring. Highly recommended.
author: 951mareikep

title: Alhambra tour
text: We had a wonderful experience visiting the Alhambra. Our guide  was extremely knowledgeable, attentive, and engaging throughout the tour. We had a great time and would highly recommend this tour and our guide to anyone visiting Granada.
author: Jet65724259722

title: Worth it. Operator was...
text: Worth it. Operator was responsive; Paola was a fantastic guide, easy going and kept the kids (and us!) engaged. Going in a small group made all the difference:  personalized guidance, skipped many lines, no need for audio (in less than~7 ppl?), photo help, breaks, and most of all, fun for kids. Early morning had cooler weather and less crowds even in peak season. Had a great experience, thanks Paola, all!
author: Yaser_K

title: Private Family Tour of the magical Alhambra
text: We had an amazing private tour today with the wonderful Paola. Her love for the Alhambra was evident as she guided us around the magical palace. She pitched everything perfectly for us and our twelve year old daughter making the experience both fun and educational. The four hours flew by and we have been left with memories and photos we will cherish forever. The communication with Alhambra Trip Granada was excellent too. I can’t recommend the experience highly enough. Thank you.
author: dominicc446

title: Outstanding Family Tour Option at the Alhambra
text: Highly reccomend this guided tour for families! Our family of four - mom, dad, and daughters (ages 7 and 10) - were grateful to have an outstanding guided tour option for our visit to the Alhambra. The booking process as well as communication beforehand was easy. Our guide Paola had wonderful energy, interesting information for all members of our family, and experience that set the right pace for our group. Highly recommend for your family's visit to Granada and especially the Alhambra!
author: M3356CWstevens

title: Alhambra Tour With Teens
text: Pablo was an excellent tour guide, h is extensive knowledge regarding the history of the Alhambra was incredibly impressive. He kept our three children engaged for almost three hours. What a beautiful place to visit, so happy we made it here and arranged for a tour - we would have missed out on so much if we hadn’t had Pablo alongside us- additionally it made the ticketing and entrance process that much easier. Highly recommend this tour!
author: Kate_D

title: Great tour!
text: Paiola was great and knowledgeable. She was entertaining and kept the kids entertained   Very efficient . We had fun!
author: Jie_Z

title: Took good care of us and our baby
text:
Private guide was perfect for us as we are with an infant. Paola was fantastic with us and with her.

The agency also got us admission tickets when the official website sold out.
author: 665yazidy

title: Gem was fantastic! Did something wonderful, amazing.
text: Visiting the Alhambra with guide was a wonderful experience. The explanations made every corner come alive, understanding its history, architecture and secrets. Undoubtedly, a must and highly recommended visit.
